        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        int a = 0, b = 1;
        double ret = x / y;
        double rett = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int val1 = (int) Math.floor(ret * i);
            int val2 = (int) Math.ceil(ret * i);
            if (Math.abs(ret - 1.0 * val1 / i) + 1e-15 < Math.abs(ret - rett)) {
                a = val1;
                b = i;
                rett = 1.0 * val1 / i;
            }
            if (Math.abs(ret - 1.0 * val2 / i) + 1e-15 < Math.abs(ret - rett)) {
                a = val2;
                b = i;
                rett = 1.0 * val2 / i;
            }
        }

        int gcd = gcd(a, b);
        System.out.println((a / gcd) + "/" + (b / gcd));
    }

    private static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            int temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
